home.title: Welcome to Klonk
home.description: Learn to code with brick figures – in Klonk-Script, blocks, JavaScript and TypeScript.

world.title: World

toolHelp.brick: Click places a brick, right-click removes one.
toolHelp.mark: Click sets or removes a mark.
toolHelp.block: Click sets or removes a block (obstacle).
toolHelp.character: Click places a character, clicking a character turns it, right-click removes it.
